meta.evidence_status: proposed design (PROVISIONAL layout by the lead; dimensions to be set by opt/inertial Rev H study)
meta.note: Provisional reference layout for the 3-D explainer and the handwriting study. Not CAD-checked; every dimension is an ASSUMPTION until results/revH/layout.json exists.

axis: z along the pen axis from the ball tip (z = 0) toward the back; x, y transverse

components.label: Ink refill (D1 mini)
components.function: Standard replaceable ink refill; its ball tip makes the ink.

components.label: Ball tip
components.function: The point that touches the paper.

components.label: Active nose
components.function: The front of the pen, holding the refill. It tilts on the pivot so the tip moves up to about ±3 mm against the handle, opposite to the hand's shake or toward a guide path.

components.label: Nose carrier tube
components.function: Stiff tube joining the nose to the pivot and the magnets.

components.label: Writing-force sensor
components.function: Measures how hard the tip presses: pen-down detection and pressure.
components.part: thin-film or strain-gauge load cell (to select)

components.label: Actuator magnet (x)
components.function: Moving magnet on the nose's rear lever; the coil pushes it to tilt the nose sideways.

components.label: Actuator magnet (y)
components.function: Moving magnet for the other axis.

components.label: Flexure pivot (2-axis)
components.function: A thin spring-steel cross flexure: lets the nose tilt in two directions with no friction or backlash, and carries the writing force along the pen.

components.label: Voice coil (x)
components.function: Electromagnet coil fixed in the handle; current through it pushes the magnet, moving the tip left-right.
components.part: custom-wound or catalogue voice coil (to select)

components.label: Voice coil (y)
components.function: Second coil for the other direction (toward and away from the writer).
components.part: custom-wound or catalogue voice coil (to select)

components.label: Position sensor (x)
components.function: Hall sensor reading the magnet: tells the controller where the tip is.

components.label: Position sensor (y)
components.function: Hall sensor for the other axis.

components.label: Handle shell
components.function: The body you hold: about 22 mm thick, easier to grip than a pencil.

components.label: Soft finger sleeve
components.function: Where the thumb, index and middle finger rest. It does not move; the nose moves inside it.

components.label: Paper-tracking camera
components.function: A tiny optical sensor beside the tip that watches the paper: it knows where the tip is on the page, for guidance and for saving your writing.

components.label: Motion sensor (IMU)
components.function: Accelerometer and gyroscope: measures the hand's shake about 2000 times a second.

components.label: Control board
components.function: Microcontroller with Bluetooth, the two coil drivers and the charger. Runs the tremor tracker and the control loop.

components.label: Rechargeable battery
components.function: Li-ion cell (14500 class, AA-sized) for a day of writing.

components.label: Vibration motor
components.function: Gives a gentle buzz as a cue: 'write bigger', 'check this word', or 'slow down'.

components.label: Inertial module (optional)
components.function: Optional spinning or sliding weight in the back of the pen that pushes the pen body against the shake (being optimised).
components.part: reaction mass or gyroscope pair (study in progress)

components.label: Charging port and button
components.function: USB-C charging and an on/off / mode button.
